unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U13: Distinguish appointed-day jurisdiction and statutory civil-court bar from constitutional review

facts.statement: Section17 jurisdiction from appointed day;18 statutory court bar with SupremeCourt/HighCourt constitutional exceptions. Tribunal establishment date matters,not merely Act commencement.

payload.title: The forum date is part of the jurisdiction analysis
payload.core_explanation_md:
The appointed day for the relevant Tribunal is different from the date an Act first commenced nationally. The source links exercise of the Tribunal powers and the corresponding statutory court bar to the established forum and its jurisdiction. A filing therefore needs both territorial/subject competence and the applicable time facts.

The statutory bar on ordinary courts for matters assigned to the Tribunal is also distinct from the preserved constitutional jurisdiction of the High Courts and Supreme Court. Constitutional review is not simply an alternative original debt suit whenever a party prefers it. Identify the actual proceeding and legal basis before deciding whether the bar applies.

self_check.prompt_text: Are Act commencement and the particular Tribunal appointed day necessarily the same date?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Establish each from the relevant legal record.

payload.stem_md: A jurisdiction note uses only the national Act commencement date although the relevant Tribunal was established later. What evidence is needed?

options.text_md: The year of the borrower incorporation only
options.explanation_md: That does not establish when the forum became operational.

options.text_md: The Tribunal establishment notification and relevant jurisdiction dates
options.explanation_md: The appointed-day framework must be applied to the actual forum.

options.text_md: The applicant preferred filing date regardless of law

options.explanation_md: Insurance timing does not establish the statutory forum.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The appointed-day framework must be applied to the actual forum.

payload.stem_md: A summary says the statutory civil-court bar abolishes all High Court constitutional jurisdiction. Which distinction corrects it?

options.text_md: A recovery suit and constitutional review are always identical
options.explanation_md: They have distinct legal bases and purposes.

options.text_md: Every borrower automatically receives a constitutional remedy on demand
options.explanation_md: Availability still depends on the applicable legal standards.

options.text_md: The bar applies only to courts outside the State
options.explanation_md: That geographical shortcut is not the statutory test.

options.text_md: Separate the assigned ordinary jurisdiction from the preserved constitutional powers
options.explanation_md: The source identifies the constitutional exceptions without making them routine debt suits.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source identifies the constitutional exceptions without making them routine debt suits.
